verdict.rationale: Caveman runs cloud services (Caveman Cloud, Cloud computers, billing and call logs), so letting users choose a storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. No evidence item mentions selecting a data region or residency. The open-source CLI working without a cloud account is an adjacent local-use option, not region choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
